source_name: Javnirazpisi.com — buyer-scoped tender aggregator
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that maintains per-naročnik profile pages (e.g. Pošta Slovenije) and topic pages (e.g. SID banka credit programmes, road mail transport), giving a ready-made historical index per buyer that is far easier to crawl than the SPA national portal. Useful as a cross-check and for back-filling history.

source_name: Javnanarocila.si — Slovenian tender guidance and listing site
why_relevant: Secondary Slovenian portal covering razpisi, conditions and procedural guidance; useful mainly as a glossary/terminology and procedure-rules pointer (thresholds, procedure types) that improves query construction against the primary portals.

source_name: Direktorat za javno naročanje (MJU) — guidelines, thresholds, e-JN rules
why_relevant: Rule-layer source: defines which of these state-linked financial buyers are obligated entities, which are sectoral (ZJN-3 'infrastrukturno področje' — relevant for Pošta Slovenije), thresholds and what must be published where. Essential for interpreting why a given buyer's tender does or does not appear on the national portal.

source_name: Mestna obcina Ljubljana - Razpisi, razgrnitve in javne objave
why_relevant: Slovenia's largest municipal buyer. Publishes its own calls, awards, ordinances (odredbe) on parking zones and payment, and annual lists of awarded contracts; the parking/ticketing policy documents here signal upcoming payment-acceptance procurement by MOL and its holding companies.

source_name: Mestna obcina Maribor - Javni razpisi in objave / Sluzba za javna narocila
why_relevant: Second-largest municipal buyer; runs centralised procurement for all city-administration bodies via its Sluzba za javna narocila, and owns Marprom which deployed open-loop Visa/Mastercard acceptance on buses in Dec 2024 - a directly payments-relevant buyer relationship.

source_name: Mestna obcina Celje - Razpisi in javne objave / Javna narocila
why_relevant: Third city municipality in the cell; maintains both a news-style razpisi section and a dedicated javna-narocila page plus a separate e-forms portal (vloge.celje.si/razpisi) carrying calls, auctions and decisions.

source_name: Mestna obcina Kranj - Javni razpisi, narocila, razgrnitve (incl. annual awarded-contract lists)
why_relevant: Kranj publishes a well-structured set of sub-pages: live javna narocila, javni razpisi, results (rezultati), archive, and - most valuable for market sizing - 'letni seznami oddanih javnih narocil' listing every contract >=10,000 EUR ex-VAT below threshold with supplier name and value. That low-value band is exactly where POS terminals, card readers and small payment integrations sit.

source_name: Mestna obcina Koper - Informacije javnega znacaja / obcinska uprava
why_relevant: Coastal city municipality with bilingual (sl/it) administration; its Sekretariat obcinske uprave handles general affairs and public procurement. Publishes calls and the mandated public-information catalogue. Some of its calls also route through Uradni list RS rather than the municipal site.

source_name: JP Ljubljanski potniski promet (LPP) / Javni holding Ljubljana - Urbana card system
why_relevant: Operator of the Urbana closed-loop city card and its mobile app; part of Javni holding Ljubljana, which procures jointly for LPP, LPT, Energetika and VOKA-Snaga. Urbana spans transit, parking, library - the widest municipal payment-acceptance estate in Slovenia and the single most important non-central buyer for card/ticketing systems.

source_name: JP Ljubljanska parkirisca in trznice (LPT) - parking payment estate
why_relevant: Operates Ljubljana's parkomati, urbanomati and garages accepting Urbana, cash, payment cards and Valu mobile wallet. Confirmed to have run a 'Nakup parkirnih sistemov' procurement that reached DKOM in 2024 - a live, verifiable payments-hardware buyer.

source_name: Javno podjetje Marprom (Maribor city transport)
why_relevant: Maribor's municipal transport operator; since 9 Dec 2024 accepts open-loop Visa/Mastercard plus Google/Apple/Garmin Pay on new on-bus validators, and runs an Urbana-style contactless card covering buses and the Pohorje cable car. A concrete, recent example of the ticketing-to-open-loop transition this cell tracks, and a repeat buyer of validators.

source_name: UKC Ljubljana - Javne objave in narocila (incl. evidencna narocila)
why_relevant: Largest Slovenian javni zavod buyer. Its 'evidencna narocila' sub-page publishes the small-value procurements (below notice threshold) where POS terminals, card readers for patient co-payments and kiosk payment systems typically sit - invisible on enarocanje.si.

source_name: UKC Maribor - Javna narocila
why_relevant: Second university medical centre; independent buyer of facility, kiosk and payment-acceptance equipment alongside its clinical procurement. Regional counterpart to UKC Ljubljana in the cell.

source_name: Splosna bolnisnica Celje - Javne objave in javna narocila / Evidencne objave
why_relevant: Representative regional general hospital (splosna bolnisnica) publishing both formal and evidencna procurement; the evidencna stream is where small payment-acceptance and kiosk purchases appear. Its annual report PDFs additionally disclose banking relationships and cash-handling arrangements.

source_name: TED - Tenders Electronic Daily (Slovenia, local authority buyers)
why_relevant: Mandatory EU-level publication for above-threshold contracts. Large municipal ticketing/parking-system and multi-year banking-service contracts cross the threshold and appear here with structured eForms fields and English translation - the cleanest machine-readable layer over the Slovene-only national notices.

source_name: Tendee - Mestna obcina Maribor javni razpisi portal
why_relevant: White-labelled SaaS portal that Maribor uses to run and publish its own calls, with structured application flows. Shows that some obcine outsource their tender front-end - a pattern worth detecting across other municipalities, since these portals hold documents the main site does not.

source_name: Skupnost obcin Slovenije (SOS) - joint municipal procurement
why_relevant: Largest representative association of Slovenian municipalities; runs SKUPNO JAVNO NAROCANJE (joint procurement) on behalf of member obcine and javni zavodi, and maintains a full member directory - the canonical actor map for this cell. Its 'javna narocila' category carries announcements of aggregated procurements, a channel that can bundle many small municipal payment needs into one large contract.

source_name: Zdruzenje obcin Slovenije (ZOS)
why_relevant: Second municipal association, with a different (largely smaller-municipality) membership than SOS. Publishes news on transparency and administrative tooling for obcine (e.g. covered the ERAR relaunch) and complements the SOS member directory for full actor coverage.

source_name: UJP - Uprava RS za javna placila
why_relevant: Structurally decisive for the 'municipal banking' topic: direct and indirect users of municipal budgets hold their accounts through UJP under a Ministry of Finance rulebook, not through freely tendered commercial bank relationships. This constrains where obcina banking-services tenders can exist at all, and redirects the addressable opportunity toward acquiring, cash handling and payment acceptance rather than account management.

source_name: Obcina Novo mesto / Skofja Loka parking-payment pages (municipal payment-method disclosures)
why_relevant: Mid-size obcine publish operational notices naming their actual parking-payment vendors and schemes (Sitium app in Novo mesto; EasyPark SMS parking with a new short number from 1 Mar 2025). These pages are the cheapest way to detect vendor switches - each switch implies a preceding or forthcoming procurement.

source_name: IJPP - Integrirani javni potniski promet (national unified ticketing scheme)
why_relevant: The national contactless-smartcard ticketing scheme that municipal urban operators (LPP, Marprom) must interoperate with; Maribor explicitly consolidated its urban and IJPP validators into one reader. Scheme-level changes and ministry RFIs cascade into municipal validator and acceptance procurement. A published English RFI invitation on gov.si confirms the ministry solicits market input on JPP systems.

source_name: NLB Group – Javni razpisi (public calls page)
why_relevant: The only bank-published 'razpis' channel found for NLB. Content observed is calls for binding offers (odkup terjatev / asset disposals) rather than supplier procurement, but it is the structural slot where NLB publishes any open market call, so it must be monitored for RFP-type announcements. Legacy alias https://www.nlb.si/javni-razpisi 301-redirects here.

source_name: NLB – Politika trajnostnega razvoja (sustainability policy PDF, supplier selection & evaluation framework)
why_relevant: States NLB Group's framework for selecting and regularly evaluating suppliers and supply-chain human-rights expectations — the closest published statement of NLB's procurement rules, useful to infer qualification criteria a vendor must satisfy.
